Reference project configuration

Projects and Engineering

A 400-ton cassava flour processing line paired with an irrigation processing plant for Angola, shown as a reference configuration.

01Processing stages

Four units make up the cassava flour line.

The proposal specifies a 400-ton project. The time basis of that figure is not stated and is confirmed with the project specification.

  1. Unit 01

    Cleaning & washing

    The reference proposal lists a complete cleaning and washing unit. Its machine list is not itemised there, so scope is defined with the project.

  2. Unit 02

    Drying

    A complete drying unit is part of the reference line. Dryer type and capacity are not itemised in the proposal and are set per project.

  3. Unit 03

    Grinding & milling

    The grinding unit combines breaking, roller milling and sifting, supported by pneumatic conveying, filtration and feeding equipment.

  4. Unit 04

    Packaging

    Finished flour is weighed and bagged in 25–50 kg units. The single-station machine is listed as an alternative item in the reference proposal.

03Conceptual scope

What a complete line includes.

  1. 01
    Equipment configuration

    Selecting and sizing machines for the product and throughput.

  2. 02
    Processing line design

    A layout study that places machines and sets the capacity and efficiency target.

  3. 03
    Material flow planning

    Product routes between stages, with flow and air piping sized to each duty.

  4. 04
    Flow and air piping

    Connection pipes in different diameters, with clips, elbows and inspection pipes.

  5. 05
    PLC wiring and control

    One panel for all machines, channelled wiring, alarms and motor protection.

  6. 06
    Equipment installation requirements

    Positioning, fixing to the ground and connecting flow and air pipes.

  7. 07
    Technical project coordination

    Keeping drawings, equipment data and site requirements aligned.

This is a simplified overview, not a finalised engineering schematic. The extent of Smarctek's involvement in design, supply or installation is agreed for each project. Equipment configurations and specifications shown are drawn from reference supplier documentation and remain subject to technical confirmation before any quotation or order.
